behavior_summary.press: Compress on :active (scale 0.985) — 120ms feedback under perceptual threshold (Bret Victor: immediate connection).
behavior_summary.magnet: Hover micro-pull (translateY -1px + scale 1.005) + JS-amplified translate3d follow (rAF-throttled).
behavior_summary.glow: Tinted radial halo on hover/focus, opacity ≤0.32, blur 14px — uses --color-tint per page.
behavior_summary.recede: Sinks 1px on click (haptic illusion of depression).
behavior_summary.card: translateY(-2px) + tinted lift-shadow on hover/focus, scale-down on active.
behavior_summary.ripple: JS sets --ripple-x/y from pointerdown coords; CSS animates radial expand 0→2.2 over 520ms; rapid-tap safe via attribute toggle reflow.
behavior_summary.magnet_engine: MutationObserver auto-attaches to lazy-mounted [data-magnet] hosts; reset on pointerleave/pointercancel/blur.
behavior_summary.pulse: Upg.life.pulse(el, 'soft'|undefined) re-triggers tactile-pulse-soft keyframe via animation-reset reflow trick.

resonance_notes: كل لمسة تردّ ميكروسكوبياً. Press يضغط، magnet يجذب، glow يهمس، ripple يُحس بالكبسة. الـ haptic illusion على non-touch devices. كل شي opt-in، لا شي auto على عناصر W12-W15.
